markets.title: Live markets
markets.body: The top 99 cryptocurrencies with prices refreshed every minute, search, sorting and 7-day charts.

coin.title: Coin deep-dive
coin.body: A detailed page for every coin: interactive chart, market stats, all-time high and low.

analyst.title: AI Analyst
analyst.body: A BUY / HOLD / SELL view for the selected coin, backed by exact numbers, with reasons and risks.

assistant.title: AI Assistant
assistant.body: Ask about crypto, trading basics or this app, in English, Arabic or Uzbek.

pick.title: Pick a coin
pick.body: Choose any coin from the top 99.

compute.title: The code calculates
compute.body: Indicators such as RSI, moving averages and volatility are computed from real market data by our code, not by the AI.

explain.title: The AI explains
explain.body: Every reason cites a real number, together with the risks and the level at which the view no longer holds.

data.title: Reliable data
data.body: Market data from CoinGecko, refreshed about every minute.

numbers.title: Numbers first
numbers.body: The AI never invents numbers: every figure it uses is checked against the data.

languages.title: Three languages
languages.body: English, Arabic with full right-to-left layout, and Uzbek.

transparent.title: Transparent
transparent.body: A clear not-financial-advice notice, and demo data is always labeled.

what.a: A web app to follow the top 99 cryptocurrencies with live prices, charts and AI-assisted educational analysis, in three languages.

data.q: Where does the data come from?
data.a: From CoinGecko. It is refreshed about every minute and can lag by a few minutes.

stablecoins.q: Why are there no stablecoins in the list?
stablecoins.a: Stablecoins and wrapped tokens track the dollar or other assets. The list focuses on coins that show real market movement.

ai.q: How does the AI analysis work?
ai.a: Our code computes the indicators; the AI explains the signal, the reasons and the risks using exactly those numbers.

advice.a: No. It is for information and education only. Your decisions are your own responsibility.

price.q: Do I need an account? Is it paid?
price.a: For now, no account is needed and the site is free.

cta.title: Start with the top 99
cta.body: Live prices, charts and clear numbers, in your language.

Footer.disclaimerShort: For information and education only. Not financial advice.

Analyst.title: AI Analyst
Analyst.intro: Get a BUY / HOLD / SELL view of {name}, built on indicators computed from market data.
Analyst.basicNote: The AI is busy right now; this is a rule-based view.

loading.hint: This can take up to 25 seconds.

invalidation.below: The view is invalid if the price moves below <v>{value}</v> ({level}).
invalidation.above: The view is invalid if the price moves above <v>{value}</v> ({level}).
invalidation.past: The view is invalid if the price moves past <v>{value}</v> ({level}).

Analyst.busy: Too many requests, try again in {n} s.

disclaimer.ai: I'm an AI model and I can make mistakes. This is not financial advice — the final decision is yours.
disclaimer.basic: This is an automatic rule-based analysis, not financial advice — the final decision is yours.

templates.trendUp: The 20-day average is above the 50-day average: the trend is up.
templates.trendDown: The 20-day average is below the 50-day average: the trend is down.
templates.trendFlat: The 20-day and 50-day averages are close: there is no clear trend.
templates.rsiOverbought: RSI is above 70: the coin looks overbought.
templates.rsiStrong: RSI is between 50 and 70: momentum is positive.
templates.rsiWeak: RSI is between 30 and 50: momentum is weak.
templates.rsiOversold: RSI is below 30: the coin looks oversold.
templates.change7dUp: The price rose more than 2% over 7 days.
templates.change7dDown: The price fell more than 2% over 7 days.
templates.change7dFlat: The price moved less than 2% over 7 days.
templates.invalidationBelow: This is the nearest known level below the current price.
templates.invalidationAbove: This is the nearest known level above the current price.

Disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
Disclaimer.intro: Yanchar Takhlil is an informational and educational tool. Nothing on this website is financial, investment, legal or tax advice.

notAdvice.title: Not financial advice
notAdvice.body: All content, including AI-generated analysis and BUY / HOLD / SELL signals, is general information only and does not consider your personal situation. Do your own research and consider consulting a licensed financial adviser before making decisions.

aiWrong.title: AI can be wrong
aiWrong.body: Our AI agents can produce inaccurate, incomplete or outdated information. Verify important facts before acting on them.

marketData.title: Market data
marketData.body: Prices and market data come from third-party providers (CoinGecko) and may be delayed, inaccurate or temporarily unavailable. Data is not real-time and can lag by a few minutes.

highRisk.title: High risk
highRisk.body: Cryptocurrencies are highly volatile. You can lose part or all of your money. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

responsibility.title: Your responsibility
responsibility.body: You are solely responsible for your investment decisions. Yanchar Takhlil is not liable for any loss arising from the use of this website.

noEndorsement.title: No endorsement
noEndorsement.body: Mentioning a cryptocurrency is not a recommendation or endorsement.
